outcome: admission to Neonatal intensive care nursery (NICU)
cohort: The study included 508 mother-infant pairs from a socioeconomically underprivileged, multiethnic population, with term neonates admitted to a level 1 nursery.
finding: Term neonates in this underprivileged multiethnic population exhibited low-intensity complications attributable to adverse maternal conditions, and optimizing maternal hematocrit may improve neonatal birth weight and maturational status while decreasing adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with lower Apgar scores, NICU admission, and a longer length of hospital stay.
birth_weight: 3196.3 g (average for neonates with Apgar scores <7)
gest_age: 38.63 weeks (average for neonates with Apgar scores <7)
